newsitem.title: USA: Macerich issues $150 mln of debentures.
newsitem.headline: Macerich issues $150 mln of debentures.

text.p: Macerich Co said Monday it had issued and sold $150 million of Convertible Subordinated Debentures due 2002.

The debentures, which were sold at par, bear interest at 7.25 percent per annum, payable semi-annually. They are convertible at any time on or after 60 days from the date of issue into shares of common stock of Macerich at a conversion price of $31.125 per share.

The conversion price represents a 10.2 percent premium over the June 19 closing price of $28.25 per share. The debentures mature on December 15, 2002 and are callable by the company after June 15, 2002 at par plus accrued interest.
The company has used the net proceeds from the financing principally to repay floating rate indebtedness.
Macerich said it intends to use the balance of the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including acquisition and redevelopment activities.
Macerich is a real estate investment trust.
